title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, U. Of California on 1985-06-14
lineage: Master PCM > DAW (via SEKD Prodif) > Wav; Mastering by Dan McDonald; All editing and sound alteration done with Diamond Cut Forensics 8.5. The recording sounded distant.  I used a 30-band equalizer and Punch & Crunch effect to give it more presence
source: Source: Schoeps CMC441s (90deg, 17cm) > Oade M118 > Oade mod SONY PCM-F1;

ai_review.summary: Stunning ambient capture with spaced omni mics that deliver crystal‑clear sound despite the unknown show details.
ai_review.review: The lone reviewer gives this recording a perfect five‑star rating, focusing on the impressive microphone setup – apparently spaced omnidirectional Schoeps capsules – and the resulting vivid, spacious audio. While no musical performance is discussed (the concert date is unknown), the technical excellence of the capture is highlighted as the main attraction.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one enthusiastic review (5 stars) praising the mic technique; rating reflects strong recording quality but limited data on performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note the use of spaced omni microphones (Schoeps), yielding a wide, clear soundstage and detailed ambience; no reported issues with clarity or balance.
